text: A few habits keep tasks working for everyone. Here are the mistakes we see most, and the fix for each.
The one thing to remember: do the work, then close the task, and keep your own list current.
One: working only the Active tab. Start every day on Expired.
Two: clicking Mark done on a task Scout made before the work is done. A chart, bill or lab task just comes back.
Three: removing a task because you can't get to it. Use Move and hand it on instead.
Four: working a queue task without clicking Assign to me, so two people do it.
Five: going on time off with tasks still in Future. Re-assign all on this tab before you go.
And when you make a task, pick a person, put the details in the notes, and give it a due date.
Remember: do the work, then close the task, and keep your own list current.
